s = bot.status()
g = s['tool_geometry_reference']
top = np.array(measurements['purple top']['surfaces_in_arm_bases']['left']['center_m'])
dest = np.array(measurements['orange top']['surfaces_in_arm_bases']['left']['center_m'])
support = measurements['table support']['surfaces_in_arm_bases']['left']
v = np.array(s['nominal_pad_pose']['arms']['left']['pad_midpoint_tool_m'])
heading = np.array([top[0], top[1], 0.0])
heading /= np.linalg.norm(heading)
opening = np.array([-heading[1], heading[0], 0.0])
grasp_options = []
for degrees in (0, 10, 15, 20, 25, 35):
    angle = np.deg2rad(degrees)
    z = np.sin(angle)*heading + np.array([0., 0., -np.cos(angle)])
    R = np.column_stack((np.cross(opening, z), opening, z))
    p = top - R @ (v + np.array([0., 0., .003]))
    corners = np.array([[x, y, t] for x in (-.013, .013)
                        for y in (-.048, .048) for t in (-.0064, .0101)])
    clearance = (p + corners @ R.T)[:, 2].min() - support['upper_m'][2]
    budget = clearance - .003 - .003
    print('tilt', degrees, 'nominal_tip_clearance_m', clearance,
          'remaining_after_pose_and_reference_allowances_m', budget)
    if budget <= 0:
        continue
    placement = p + np.array([dest[0]-top[0], dest[1]-top[1],
                              dest[2]-support['center_m'][2]])
    poses = {'grasp': p, 'view': p-z*.055, 'lift': p+[0, 0, .045],
             'transfer': placement+[0, 0, .035], 'placement': placement}
    checks = {}
    for name, point in poses.items():
        result = bot.plan_move(left_x=float(point[0]), left_y=float(point[1]),
                               left_z=float(point[2]), rotation={'left': R})
        checks[name] = bool(result['reachable'] and
                            result.get('tracking_reserve', {}).get('passed', False))
        print(degrees, name, checks[name], result.get('reason', ''))
    if all(checks.values()):
        grasp_options.append({'rotation': R, 'poses': poses, 'budget_m': budget})
